Marty's Monday Women's Ride

Morristown, NJ · Loantaka Park · Road

Women / trans / femmeNo-dropBeginner friendly

Marty's Monday Women's Ride is a road group ride in Morristown, NJ. It rolls every Monday at 9:30 am from Loantaka Park. About 15–20 miles, 12–14 mph, no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @martysreliable the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Marty's Monday Women's Ride group ride

A no-drop women's road ride from Loantaka Park. Routes run 15 to 20 miles at 12 to 14 mph. Updates go in the Team Marty's Women Facebook group. Helmet and waiver required.
